tagline: Helping people achieve a lifetime of financial security
hero_kpi_rationale: Aegon generates EUR 12.3 billion in recurring revenue from insurance premiums and management fees, reflecting the stability and predictability of the insurance business model.

ai_positioning.summary: Aegon takes a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, mainly using it for customer data analytics and risk management. AI is not a central strategic lever but a tool for operational efficiency.
evidence: Integration of ESG factors into investment analysis
Engagement with portfolio companies on sustainability

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the underlying performance of insurance and asset management activities.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin shows slight improvement thanks to organizational simplification.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.description: R&D expenses are marginal, oriented toward limited digital innovation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Investments are primarily focused on internal IT and system modernization.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: The group continues its organizational simplification with productivity gains.

kpis.name: Service / Subscription / ARR Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from asset management and insurance services.
kpis.description: Recurring revenues come mainly from insurance premiums and management fees. In 2018, Aegon administered more than EUR 800 billion of investments for its clients.
kpis.signal: Recurring base growing, revenue visibility rising

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
